description: "The Negro: What is His Ethnological Status? 2nd Ed." by Ariel is a scientific publication written in the late 19th century. The book addresses complex and controversial questions regarding the ethnological status of the Black race in relation to biblical narratives, particularly focusing on the lineage of Noah’s sons and the implications of various interpretations of their characteristics.
